data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Heera means star or radiant. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘heeram’, which signifies brilliance or luminosity. In Hindu mythology, Heera is associated with the stars and is a symbol of beauty, power, and grace. The name Heera carries the meaning “Star, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Heera usually hope their child will grow to embody star, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner radiance and beauty of an individual.
data.etymology: Heera belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Star, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, success, and good fortune to the child.
